optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Project Manager, Insurance Policy Administration Migration
professionalSummary: Three‑year project manager for a life and pensions insurer, responsible for migration plans, reconciliation schedules, steering reports, dependency management, go‑live readiness, and closure documentation for three product tranches.
experienceHighlights: Owned migration plans and reconciliation schedules for three tranches under the insurer’s delivery framework.
Prepared weekly steering reports and presented reconciliation breaks to the steering committee for 31 sessions.
Managed vendor and policy operations dependencies via the framework’s dependency log, escalating vendor slips to the committee.
Prepared go‑live readiness reviews, documenting responsibilities and recording steering committee decisions.
Authored closure reports with project boundary statements and reconciliation evidence accepted by finance controllers.
projectsAndWorkSamples: Migration plan and reconciliation schedule for a tranche.
Committee minutes for two steering sessions.
Go‑live readiness review with steering committee decision.
Closure report with reconciliation evidence and project boundary statement.
Migration repository references as verification trail.
optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The provided resume and work samples establish the candidate’s experience and responsibilities in migration planning, steering reporting, dependency management, go‑live readiness, and closure documentation for three tranches. They do not provide evidence of experience outside these tranches or with other insurers.

decisionBoundary.statement: Candidate’s experience aligns with all listed requirements; human review recommended to confirm fit.

role.roleTitle: Project Manager, Insurance Policy Administration Migration

evidence.text: Project manager on a life and pensions insurer's policy administration migration for three years, owning the migration plans and reconciliation schedules of three product tranches under the insurer's delivery framework.
Work sample: one migration plan with its reconciliation schedule...

Prepared the weekly steering report for each tranche and presented the reconciliation breaks to the steering committee; the committee minutes record the questions raised on each break and the explanations accepted across the thirty-one weekly sessions I presented.
Interview note: candidate separated policies, gave counts and amounts, named owners, and answered follow‑up on data error with specific field.
Kept the platform vendor and policy operations dependencies moving through the framework's dependency log, taking three vendor slips to the committee for escalation.

Reference call with the former head of policy migration: confirmed the candidate ran the three tranches and presented to the committee in the period, that go-live decisions stayed with the committee, and confirmed the dates.

Prepared the go-live readiness review for each tranche; the go-live decision was the steering committee's, recorded on the review together with which checks were mine and which were policy operations'

Reference call with the former head of policy migration: confirmed the candidate ran the three tranches and presented to the committee in the period, that go-live decisions stayed with the committee, and confirmed the dates.
Wrote the closure report for each tranche with the project boundary statement and the reconciliation evidence accepted by the finance controller.
Work sample: ... one closure report, with the migration repository references as a verification trail.
